prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no one objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash, injuries, the insurance issues involved, and how comfortable you are with the lawyer. I can help you find strong candidates, but here’s how to pick the best one for your situation.

What to look for
- Relevant experience: regular handling of car-accident cases (not just general practice) and courtroom/trial experience if your case might go to trial.  
- Track record: documented settlements and verdicts in car-accident matters, especially those similar in severity to yours.  
- Resources: ability to hire experts (medical, accident reconstruction) and cover case costs while working on contingency.  
- Communication: clear point of contact, timely responses, and straightforward explanations of strategy and fees.  
- Local knowledge: experience with the courts, judges, and insurance companies in Cook County/Chicago.  
- Client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo, local bar awards).

Red flags
- Promises of a specific dollar amount up front.  
- Pressure to accept a quick, low settlement.  
- No trial experience if your case may require litigation.  
- Poor communication during the free consultation.

Questions to ask at your free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? Will you or an associate?  
- What was a recent settlement/verdict you obtained for a case like mine?  
- What is your fee structure and any additional costs I may owe?  
- How do you communicate with clients and how often will I get updates?

Where to find reputable Chicago attorneys
- Chicago Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service  
- Illinois State Bar Association directories  
- Super Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale‑Hubbell (look at ratings, client reviews, peer review)  
- Word-of-mouth from friends/family or your treating doctor

Typical fee structure and timelines
- Most personal injury lawyers work on contingency (commonly 33%–40% of recovery, sometimes sliding or different for trial).  
- Many car-accident claims settle in months, but more serious injury claims or disputed liability cases can take 1–2 years or longer.

If you’d like, I can:
- Search and provide a short vetted list (3–5) of Chicago personal injury attorneys who specialize in car accidents with recent results and ratings, or  
- Help you draft specific questions to ask at consultations.

Tell me a bit about your case (where in Chicago the crash occurred, severity of injuries, whether fault is disputed, and any deadlines) and I’ll put together a targeted list.
